newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC raises wheat exports, cuts stocks forecast.
newsitem.headline: ONIC raises wheat exports, cuts stocks forecast.

text.p: French soft wheat exports to non-EU countries were forecast to rise by 150,000 tonnes to 6.4 million tonnes in 1996/97, France's grain office ONIC confirmed on Wednesday.

In a new supply/demand report released ahead of its monthly news conference, ONIC lowered its estimate for soft wheat carryover stocks at end-June 1997 to 2.061 million tonnes from 2.185 million at June 1996.
France exported 3.75 million tonnes of soft wheat to non-EU countries in 1995/96 and ended the season with a carryover stock of 2.212 million.
ONIC also put wheat exports to other EU countries at 9.135 million tonnes, barely changed from 9.035 million estimated in February. This compares with exports of 8.613 million in 1995/96.
ONIC slightly cut its target for the soft wheat crop in 1996 to 34.578 million tonnes from 34.616 million in February.
France harvested a crop of 29.825 million in 1995.
Commercial flour exports outside the European Union were unchanged at a grain equivalent of two million tonnes. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
